ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85-90% low-intensity (dark grey/black) to 10-15% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution across the visible fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark contiguous base with high-contrast white linear streaks and clusters. High-intensity white pixels are concentrated at the far lateral tips and scattered in linear arrays across the central and medial lobe surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of approximately 80 degrees; central indentation reaches a deep focal point relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations present along the entire trailing edge of both lobes, characterized by jagged peaks and valleys isolated against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward sweep from the median notch toward the lateral tips, ending in sharp, tapered upward-curving points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of small, circular, high-contrast white pixel spots are visible on the distal tips, particularly concentrated on the right-most tip and upper-left margin.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of multi-directional white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible across both lobes, with high concentration in the lower-left and central-right regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks (parallel linear scars) and several small irregular notches along the trailing edge topography; small white circular lesions/scars on the upper-right tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible cluster of small, raised white circular objects (likely barnacles) on the extreme right lateral tip.
